title: Complementary Information Sources
abstract: arXiv:2609.29066v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A decision maker may have several information sources available and choose which one to consult only after learning the decision problem she faces. When is one such set of sources uniformly more valuable than another? For unrestricted Bayesian decision problems, we show that the answer can be stated entirely in terms of Blackwell comparisons. Form a tagged mixture by drawing a source independently of the state and revealing both its identity and its signal. One source set is more valuable in every decision problem if and only if each tagged mixture of the second source set is Blackwell dominated by some tagged mixture of the first. The result applies to compact, possibly infinite source sets and general signal spaces. It also has an exact quantitative counterpart: the largest normalized value shortfall is the directed Le Cam deficiency between the source sets' tagged hulls. translated_abstract: 决策者可能拥有多个可用的信息来源，并且只有在了解自己所面临的决策问题之后，才选择咨询其中哪一个。那么，在什么情况下一组信息来源一致地比另一组更有价值？对于不受限制的贝叶斯决策问题，我们证明答案可以完全用 Blackwell 比较来表述。通过独立于状态抽取一个信息来源并同时揭示其身份与信号，可以构造出一个“标记混合”。一组信息来源在每一个决策问题中都更有价值，当且仅当第二组来源的每个标记混合都被第一组来源的某个标记混合所 Blackwell 支配。该结果适用于紧的、可能是无限的信息来源集合以及一般的信号空间。它还有一个精确的定量对应：最大的归一化价值缺口等于两组信息来源的标记凸包之间的有向 Le Cam 缺乏度。针对单调决策问题的类似研究则揭示了……
tldr: 本文通过引入“标记混合”概念，证明了一组信息来源在所有贝叶斯决策问题中一致更有价值当且仅当其某个标记混合 Blackwell 支配另一组的每个标记混合，并给出以标记凸包间有向 Le Cam 缺乏度度量价值缺口的精确定量版本。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that one set of information sources is uniformly more valuable than another across all Bayesian decision problems if and only if every tagged mixture of the latter is Blackwell dominated by some tagged mixture of the former, with an exact quantitative counterpart in the directed Le Cam deficiency between the sets' tagged hulls.
